_comment: Copy this to config.json (or point the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable at another path). This file contains only database and skill_dir; other configuration such as LLM is supplied through environment variables or in-app settings, not here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: the ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) fill in only database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database block above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, containing SKILL.md). Priority: the ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
